boundary_condition: Apply only to hotel room amenity selection; do not infer a preferred destination, view, bed type, star rating, breakfast plan, or other one-off amenities from this habit.
condition: When selecting a hotel room and in-room amenities are part of the lodging search.
default_action: Prioritize hotel rooms that include a coffeemaker in the room.
exception_condition: If no room with a coffeemaker satisfies the explicit trip constraints, or if the traveler explicitly deprioritizes the amenity for that stay, choose an otherwise suitable room without requiring a coffeemaker.
name: Prefers hotel rooms with a coffeemaker
rationale: Multiple independent hotel-search dialogues request or check for a coffeemaker as a room amenity. The repeated amenity supports a controlled synthetic-user default for preferring an in-room coffeemaker, while the other listed amenities remain transaction-specific.

source_evidence.contribution: User lists "coffeemaker" among desired in-room hotel amenities.
User requests a room "with the coffeemaker inside the room," grounding the in-room scope of the amenity.
User asks for a room with "a coffeemaker" along with other hotel criteria.
User says, "I'd like to have a wet bar and coffeemaker," supporting the coffeemaker as a desired hotel room amenity.
User asks whether the hotel has a "mini fridge and coffeemaker," showing the coffeemaker is a checked amenity in hotel selection.

source_examples.user_utterance: I'd like to have an ocean-view, balcony, a mini refrigerator, a king bed in room, coffeemaker and flat screen TV.
I want a one king bed and one sofa bed with the coffeemaker inside the room with free breakfast.
I'm looking for a room that has a balcony, a queen-size bed and a coffeemaker as well as the hotel being a four-stars rated and above.
I'd like to have a wet bar and coffeemaker.
Okay. And does it have mini fridge and coffeemaker? How can you tell me?
